_comment: Miro's two-option replies (docs/INNER_CONFLICT.md). Each one is spliced into an existing scene right after the line whose text contains 'after' (speaker ignored, so renames like KEEPER -> JUDAS don't break it). Option 1 is always the quiet side (hide, watch, ask), option 2 the loud side (fight, endure). A reply only colours Miro's leaning (and so the paintings and the verses the Keepers quote); the scene then continues exactly as written, so the story never forks. 'reply' is an optional one-line reaction; speaker '@anchor' means whoever spoke the anchor line. If the anchor line is reworded, the choice silently disappears. Ids start with l<floor>_ so a retry forgets that floor's answers.

choices.after: doesn't pay me enough to care
choices.prompt: He's sick, and he sells what's left of us.

options.text: Then don't look. That's all I need from you.
Keep looking away. You're good at it.
reply: Careful. I can still hear you.

choices.after: You used to. Stay there. Let me help you.
choices.prompt: A voice behind bars, asking me to trust it.

options.text: Then tell me who I was.

choices.after: I cannot stop shaking. Please... stand back.
choices.prompt: He's terrified of me. Or of what they'll do if I'm seen here.

options.text: I'm not here. You never saw me.
Whoever did this to you will answer for it.
reply: Don't. They'll only take more of us.

choices.after: We used to trust each other.
choices.prompt: He wants me to come back. Back to what?

options.text: If we trusted each other, you'd tell me why I'm here.

choices.after: My name. Their uniform. I was one of them.
choices.prompt: If I was one of them, I know how this place works.

options.text: Then I know their doors, their cameras, their passwords.
Then I know exactly where it hurts.

choices.after: I thought we were helping people.
choices.prompt: My brother. I want that to mean something.

options.text: I want to believe you, Niro.

choices.prompt: Numbers where the names should be.

options.text: Somebody has to remember them. I'll copy the numbers.
Every page of this goes down with the tower.

choices.after: we can still make this work.
choices.prompt: He's still asking me to stop. I'm still not stopping.

options.text: Then don't follow me. You won't see me again until it's done.
Then stay out of my way.
